_what: The places a person's automatic replies go to, one row per place, read by one code path (read-data/reply-rules.mjs, do-work/decide-the-replies.mjs, do-work/send-a-reply.mjs). A place row says: which kind of connection reaches the account (connection_vendor), which tool row sends to it (send_tool), whose own words are never answered (self_id: {snapshot_state: true} the account id its pull kept, or {plain: field} a readable field of the person's connection record), and its channels. A channel is one kind of thing that can be answered: where its items come from (pull: {snapshot: name} the pulled threads of that source, or {handed_in: {tool, items_path}} the answer of that pull tool, handed to the decide row as pulled.<channel id>), which of a thread's messages are answered (which: latest, or each), where each field of an item is (fields, as dotted paths; thread_id is a path in the thread), what to say when the person wrote it (own_reason), who the reply goes to (recipient, a template of the item's fields), how long after the item a reply is still allowed (window_ms, or null for no window), and the request that sends it (request: method, url, optional body; a {name} is filled from the decision, a field of the form {recipient} stands for the whole object). send says which hosts the held token may go to, its descriptor and the header it goes in as {token}. A new place is one more row here and one send row that holds its connection; nothing in the code names a place.
